context: TCGTracking has a documented API: your key plus shipper number, label create, tracking lookup by TCGplayer order number, no push notices. 'Token routing' fits more than one build.

options.gain: No browser extension in the middle.
options.how: Banchi's server holds your key from its local settings file and calls TCGTracking directly.
options.label: Banchi's server calls the API
options.lose: A second place that can spend money, so it needs an approve-before-spend screen.

options.how: The Bridge extension keeps importing orders; Banchi only reads tracking back.
options.label: Keep the extension, Banchi reads back

ref: TCGTracking review round 2; your words: 'a stronger pipe to and from banchi and tcgtracking'
title: How should Banchi and TCGTracking connect?
why: One pipe you control, and spending stays behind a screen you approve.
